thread.title: Apple Stock Falls Despite Big Price-Target Hike On New Products

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Stock Falls Despite Big Price-Target Hike On New Products
text:
Apple stock slumped on Friday despite getting a bullish assessment from a Wall Street analyst on prospects for its new iPhones and Apple Watch.
X Monness Crespi Hardt analyst Brian White reiterated his buy rating on Apple ( AAPL ) and upped his price target to 300 from 275.
Apple stock fell 1.1% to 223.84 on the stock market today . The stock succumbed to what has become a traditional iPhone launch curse for the week.
For the past 11 iPhone introductions, since the original handset, Apple stock has fallen on average 1.6% for the week. It has fallen in seven of those 11 iPhone launch weeks. Apple ended Friday a penny lower than where it ended on Tuesday, the day before the iPhone XS launch. So the stock was flat post-launch.
On Wednesday, when Apple introduced its 12th-generation iPhones, its shares fell 1.2% for the day. Apple stock has fallen on nine of the past 11 iPhone launch days, including the latest.
New iPhones 'Compelling' Upgrades White raised his price target on Apple stock based on the outlook for the company's new products. Those products include the iPhone XS, XR and XS Max, which have screen sizes ranging from 5.8 inches to 6.5 inches. The higher-than-expected prices for those premium handsets should lead to favorable average selling prices for the company, he said.
The new iPhones provide "compelling reasons" for consumers to upgrade, he said. The new phones boast improved performance, faster processors and better cameras.
"Moreover, we look forward to continued momentum in services and we believe Apple's hard-line stance on data privacy will increasingly be rewarded," White said in a report to clients. "In our view, the best days of innovations are still in front of Apple."
In addition to the three new iPhones, Apple unveiled its Apple Watch Series 4. The new smartwatch boasts enhanced health and fitness features with a focus on the heart.
